verses.sanskrit:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच।
              अथ यो विजिगीषेत क्षत्रियः क्षत्रियं युधि। कस्तस्य विजये धर्मो ह्येतं पृष्टो ब्रवीहि मे॥१॥
verses.english: Yudhishthira said You have already explained to me O grandfather, how the religion of Yoga, which produces six well-known attributes, may be adopted and practised without injuring any creature. Describe to me, O grandfather that religion which produces enjoyment and Liberation. O these two, both of which lead to the same end, which is superior?”

verses.sanskrit:
भीष्म उवाच।
              ससहायोऽसहायो वा राष्ट्रमागम्य भूमिपः। ब्रूयादहं वो राजेति रक्षिष्यामि च वः सदा॥२॥
verses.english: Bhishma said “Both courses of duty are highly sacred. Both are extremely difficult of performance. Both yield high fruits. Both are practised by those who are admittedly good.

verses.sanskrit: मम धर्मबलिं दत्त किं वा मां प्रतिपत्स्यथ। ते चेत्तमागतं तत्र वृणुयुः कुशलं भवेत्॥३॥
verses.english: I shall now describe to you on the authoritativeness of both these duties, for removing your doubts about their true meaning. Listen to me with rapt attention.

verses.sanskrit: ते चेदक्षत्रियाः सन्तो विरुध्येरन्कथंचन। सर्वोपायैर्नियन्तव्या विकर्मस्था नराधिप॥४॥
verses.english: Regarding it is cited the old discourse between Kapila and the cow. Listen to it, O Yudhishthira.

verses.sanskrit: अशस्त्रं क्षत्रियं मत्वा शस्त्रं गृह्णात्यथापरः। त्राणायाप्यसमर्थं तं मन्यमानमतीव च॥५॥
verses.english: We have heard that in days of yore when the god Tashtri came to the palace of king Nahusha, the latter, for satisfying the duties of hospitality, was on the point of slaying a cow in accordance with the true, ancient, and eternal injunction of the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच।
              अथ यः क्षत्रियो राजा क्षत्रियं प्रत्युपाव्रजेत्। कथं सम्प्रति योद्धव्यस्तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥६॥
verses.english: Seeing that cow tied for slaughter, Kapila of liberal soul, ever following Sattvika duties, always engaged in controlling his senses, endued with true knowledge, and sparing in diet, having gained an excellent understanding that was characterised by faith, perfectly fearless, beneficial, firm, and ever directed towards truth, uttered-Alas, ye Vedas!-At that time a Rishi by name Syumarashmi, entering the form of that cow, addressed the Yati Kapila, saying,-Silence, O Kapila! If the Vedas are censurable, whence have those other duties come to regarded as authoritative.

verses.sanskrit:
भीष्म उवाच।
              नैवासन्नद्धकवचो योद्धव्यः क्षत्रियो रणे। एक एकेन वाच्यश्च विसृजेति क्षिपामि च॥७॥
verses.english: Men given to penances and endued with intelligence, and who have the Shrutis and knowledge for their eyes, consider the injunctions of the Vedas, which have been declared through and compiled by the Rishis, to be the words of God himself.

verses.sanskrit: स चेत्सन्नद्ध आगच्छेत्सन्नद्धव्यं ततो भवेत्। स चेत्ससैन्य आगच्छेत्ससैन्यस्तमथाह्वयेत्॥८॥
verses.english: What can a person say regarding the contents of the Vedas when these are the words of the Supreme Being himself, who is shorn of the desire of fruit, who is without the fever, who is addicted to nothing, and who is shorn of all exertion.

verses.sanskrit: स चेन्निकृत्या युद्ध्येत निकृत्या प्रतियोधयेत्। अथ चेद्धर्मतो युद्ध्येद्धर्मेणैव निवारयेत्॥९॥
verses.english: Kapila said-I do not censure the Vedas, I do not wish to disparage them. We have heard that the different classes of duty laid down for the different modes of life, all lead to the same end.

verses.sanskrit: नाश्वेन रथिनं यायादुदियाद्रथिनं रथी। व्यसने न प्रहर्तव्यं न भीताय जिताय च॥१०॥
verses.english: The Sanyasin attains to a high end. The herinit also attains to a hight end. Both the other two, also, viz., the house-holder and the Brahmacharin, attain to the same end.

verses.sanskrit: इषुर्लिप्तो न कर्णी स्यादसतामेतदायुधम्। यथार्थमेव योद्धव्यं न क्रुद्ध्येत जिघांसतः॥११॥
साधूनां तु यदा भेदात्साधुश्चेद्व्यसनी भवेत्। निष्प्राणो नाभिहन्तव्यो नानपत्यः कथंचन॥१२॥
verses.english: All the four modes of life have always been considered as Deva-yana ways. The respective strength or weakness of these, are represented by their respective superiority or inferiority, has been declared in the character of their respective ends.

verses.sanskrit: भग्नशस्त्रो विपन्नश्च कृत्तज्यो हतवाहनः। चिकित्स्यः स्यात्स्वविषये प्राप्यो वा स्वगृहे भवेत्॥१३॥
verses.english: Knowing these, perform acts which lead to heaven and other blessings,—this is a Vedic declaration.-Do not perform acts,—this also is another obligatory declaration of the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: निर्व्रणश्च स मोक्तव्य एष धर्मः सनातनः। तस्माद्धर्मेण योद्धव्यमिति स्वायम्भुवोऽब्रवीत्॥१४॥
verses.english: If abstention from acts produces merit, then their performance must be highly reprehensible. When the scriptures say this, the strength or weakness of particular sayings must be difficult to determine.

verses.sanskrit: सत्सु नित्यः सतां धर्मस्तमास्थाय न नाशयेत्। यो वै जयत्यधर्मेण क्षत्रियो धर्मसंगरः॥१५॥
verses.english: If you know of any class of duty which is superior to the religion of harmlessness, and which depends upon direct evidence instead of that of the scriptures, do you then describe them to me,

verses.sanskrit: आत्मानमात्मना हन्ति पापो निकृतिजीवनः। कर्म चैतदसाधूनामसाधून् साधुना जयेत्॥१६॥
verses.english: One should celebrate sacrifices from desire of heaven'-we always hear this Shruti. Thinking first of the fruit, one makes preparations for sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मेण निधनं श्रेयो न जयः पापकर्मणा। नाधर्मश्चरितो राजन्सद्यः फलति गौरिव॥१७॥
verses.english: Like a cow a sinful act does not yield immediate truits. If the fruit is not seen in the perpetrator himself, it is seen in his son or in his grand-son or daughter's son.

verses.sanskrit: मूलानि च प्रशाखाश्च दहन्समधिगच्छति। पापेन कर्मणा वित्तं लब्ध्वा पापः प्रहृष्यति॥१८॥
verses.english: Goat, horse, sheep, cow, all sorts of birds, domestic or wild, and herbs and plants, constitute the food of living creatures. We have heard this.

verses.sanskrit: स वर्धमानः स्तेयेन पापः पापे प्रसज्जति। न धर्मोऽस्तीति मन्वानः शुचीनवहसन्निव॥१९॥
verses.english: Food again ought to be taken day after day morning and evening. Again the Shruti says that aniinals and grain form the limbs of Sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: अश्रद्दधानश्च भवेद्विनाशमुपगच्छति। सम्बद्धो वारुणैः पाशैरमर्त्य इव मन्यते॥२०॥
verses.english: The Lord of the universe created them along with Sacrifice. The powerful Lord of all creatures made the god celebrate sacrifices with their help.

verses.sanskrit: महादृतिरिवाध्मातः सुकृते नैव वर्तते। ततः समूलो ह्रियते नदीकूलादिव द्रुमः॥२१॥
अथैनमभिनिन्दन्ति भिन्नं कुम्भमिवाश्मनि। तस्माद्धर्मेण विजयं कोशं लिप्सेत भूमिपः॥२२॥
verses.english: Altogether seven (domestic) and seven (wild animals are declared fit for sacrifice. Instead of all being equally fit, each succeeding one is inferior to the preceding one. The Vedas again say that the whole universe is appointed for sacrifice. The Vedas have appointed Purusha for the same purpose.
